transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, a student is scheduled to return to school next Monday after completing a three-day suspension following the cafeteria altercation. Before I can approve the return-to-school behavior plan, I need to gather current implementation information from each of you. Per our re-entry policy, I need updates from classroom staff, counseling, and family-support staff. The plan must address supervision during unstructured periods, daily check-ins, extracurricular participation, and communication with the student's caregiver. Could each of you share what you currently know regarding this student's situation so we can build an appropriate plan together?
